text: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせたら　よいですか？

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means making or letting someone do something. おぼえさせる = 'make learn, teach'.

patterns.name: 〜たらいい
patterns.span: おぼえさせたら　よい
patterns.explanation: たら plus いい asks or says 'it would be good if'. おぼえさせたら　よいですか = 'which one should I teach it to?'.
